ui.hero_title: Private apps, no ads, no middlemen
ui.hero_text: Direct downloads of APKs and Windows installers from the original releases. Every file is published with its SHA-256 fingerprint so you can check it's authentic.
ui.not_found: This app isn't in the catalog.

ui.p_confirm: Confirm the installation in the Android window.

ui.about_intro_html: Sunsam Apps Store brings Jhon Supelano's apps together in one place without depending on Google Play. The catalog is an open file (apps.json) hosted on GitHub Pages, and every download comes straight from the GitHub release where it was published.
ui.store_card_text: Install, update and open apps with one tap. It checks each APK's SHA-256 before installing it. Works on Google TV too.
ui.step1: Download the APK from the app's page (or install the store app to do everything from your phone).
ui.step2_html: Android will ask you to allow installs from this source: Settings → Install unknown apps. Only enable it for your browser or the store.
ui.step3_html: Open the file and tap Install. If you already have the Google Play version, you may need to uninstall it first: the signatures can differ.
ui.trust_h2: Why you can trust every file
ui.trust_html: Every app page shows the APK's SHA-256 fingerprint and its signing certificate. The store app compares the downloaded file's fingerprint before handing it to the Android installer; if it doesn't match, it deletes the file and doesn't install it. On Windows you can check it with Get-FileHash file.apk.
ui.oss_text: Some apps are open source and link to their repository. Others have private code: for those, only the installers are published, never the source code.
ui.shots_lang_note: Screenshots are shown in the app's original language.

opencallshield.tagline: Block spam calls with an open, community-driven list
opencallshield.description:
A private, decentralized alternative to Truecaller. OpenCallShield uses Android's official call screening service (Android 10 or later) to reject or silence spam calls before your phone rings.

Everything is decided on your device with a rules engine and a local database; the list of reported numbers syncs with a public file on GitHub that anyone can contribute to.
features: Automatic blocking: rejects or silences spam calls
Rules engine: allowed contacts, reported numbers and suspicious prefixes
Block calls by country
Public community database with daily sync
History of filtered calls and your own reports
Open source (MIT), no ads or trackers

safevault.tagline: On-device AI finds your sensitive photos and encrypts them
safevault.description:
SafeVault scans your gallery and camera with AI models that run inside your phone, decides which images are sensitive (IDs, cards, private screenshots) and stores them in an AES-256 encrypted vault that only opens with your fingerprint, your screen lock or your password.

It has no server of its own: the only internet connection is the initial model download. No cloud, no accounts.
features: Automatic guardian: checks every new photo in the background
Consensus router across several on-device models
AES-256 encrypted vault with fingerprint, system lock or password
Manual review of anything the AI flags as uncertain
8 languages and dark mode
Android 9 or later
safevault.notes: In testing on Google Play (v0.6.2). The direct APK is version 0.6.1.

idpersonalsecure.tagline: Your encrypted digital wallet for IDs, no cloud
idpersonalsecure.description:
A personal vault for your identity documents, on Android and Windows. Everything is encrypted locally with AES-256-GCM and a key derived from your PIN; no document is stored in plain text or leaves your device.

You can export your vault to a .securevault file on one device and import it on the other.
features: AES-256-GCM encryption with a PIN-derived key (PBKDF2, 210,000 iterations)
Documents with issue and expiry dates, filters and search
PDF or image attachments
Export and import between Android and Windows
Offline-first with dark mode

docuscaner.tagline: Enlarge ID documents to 150%, ready to print
docuscaner.description:
Enlarges identity documents and gets them ready to print on a letter-size sheet at the exact physical size institutions ask for: 150% of the original (13.2 x 8.25 cm) or any factor you need. Built for print shops, copy centers and personal paperwork.

All processing happens on your phone; your documents are never sent to any server.
features: Enlarge to 100%, 150%, 200% or any factor, with real measurements
Front and back on a single letter-size sheet
Color, black and white and high-contrast modes
Multi-page scanner to PDF and finger cropping
PIN-protected encrypted vault and AES-256 backups
Windows version (MSI)
docuscaner.notes: The direct APK is the Documentos150 edition (package com.iddoc150), which installs separately from the Google Play version. The unlimited license can only be bought on Google Play.

printorganize.tagline: Your photos in Word at the exact size in centimeters
printorganize.description:
Turns a folder of images into a Word document with the photos arranged in a grid at exactly the physical size you choose. If you need 6 x 6 cm photos, they come out 6 x 6 cm: not a millimeter more.

Pick the folder, type the size and tap Generate. The app works out how many fit per page and saves a print-ready .docx. No servers, no accounts and no ads.
features: Exact size for each image in centimeters
A4, Letter, Legal and A3 sheets, portrait or landscape
Exact or fit mode, automatic margins and columns
File name under each image and subfolder support
PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, WEBP and HEIC
Also available on Microsoft Store
printorganize.notes: Installed outside Google Play, in-app purchase doesn't work: for the unlimited license, install from Google Play or Microsoft Store.

compartirarchivosred.tagline: Send files between Android, Windows and Linux over your Wi-Fi
compartirarchivosred.description: Transfer files on your local network between Android phones, Windows PCs and Linux computers. Devices find each other automatically, pair with a 6-digit PIN and files travel straight over your Wi-Fi: no cloud and no cables.
features: Automatic discovery on the same network
Secure pairing with an expiring PIN
Several files at once, large files and a progress bar
Built-in file explorer
Android, Windows (MSI) and Linux (.deb)

openwirelessdisplay.tagline: Use your Android as a wireless second monitor for your PC
openwirelessdisplay.description:
An open-source alternative to Spacedesk: turns one or more Android devices into wireless secondary monitors for a Windows PC, mirrored or extended, on the same Wi-Fi network.

Install the server on Windows (MSI) and the app on your phone; they find each other and pair with a PIN.
features: Extended mode: your phone works as a brand-new monitor
Several phones at once, each showing a different monitor
Automatic discovery on the network or manual IP connection
Pairing with a 6-digit PIN
Low latency and a visible cursor on virtual monitors
openwirelessdisplay.notes: Requires the Windows server installed on the PC.

paybio.tagline: Payment-method wallet with QR codes, 100% local with on-device AI
paybio.description:
PayBio stores your payment methods (banks, digital wallets and crypto addresses) and shows them as cards with a QR code ready to share, offline and without servers: the app doesn't even request internet permission.

Upload a screenshot of your banking app and the local AI (ML Kit) builds the card for you. Includes a kiosk mode for counters and Android TV support.
features: Smart import from screenshots or text with on-device AI
Catalog by country: banks, wallets and blockchain networks
PIN-protected kiosk mode for counters and TV screens
SQLCipher-encrypted database
Encrypted .zip backups, no cloud
Home-screen widget and one-tap QR sharing

turnosdispensario.tagline: Queue and medicine dispensing system with AI prescription OCR
turnosdispensario.description: A medicine dispensary system with queue tickets, AI reading of medical prescriptions and batch inventory (FEFO). It runs on your local network without internet: a Windows server plus Android apps for staff, patients and queue display screens.
features: Tickets with QR and PIN, on-screen calls and phone vibration
AI prescription OCR plus manual search
Batch inventory with expiry dates and barcode scanner
Self-service kiosk with thermal ticket printing
Automatic server discovery on the local network
Signed receipts and a full audit trail
turnosdispensario.notes: The Android apps need the Windows server on the same network.

reciclaje.tagline: Smart queue system for recycling centers, no internet needed
reciclaje.description: Management system for recycling centers: queue tickets, weighing with live value calculation, signed receipts, payment approval and baled-material inventory. Everything runs on your local network with a Windows server and Android apps for each role.
features: Roles: customer, weighing, administrator, inventory and kiosk
Tickets with QR and PIN, plus vibration alerts
Receipts signed with HMAC-SHA256
Dedicated TV app that starts automatically
Offline-first with automatic server discovery
reciclaje.notes: The Android apps need the Windows server on the same network.

klanly.tagline: Paid communities with courses and memberships
klanly.description:
A Skool-style platform for paid communities: creators build their community, charge memberships and publish courses; members pay, take part and learn. Includes a web app, an Android app, an Android TV app and an admin dashboard for Windows.

Payments work through a payment gateway or a manual receipt.
features: Communities with monthly memberships in USD or COP
Dual payments: gateway (Wompi) or manual receipt
Android, Android TV and web apps
Admin dashboard for Windows
Open source and free

cuentero.description:
Cuentero Infinito invents stories that didn't exist a minute ago and reads them aloud. Ask for a lighthouse keeper who collects storms or tap “Surprise me”: no story ever repeats.

The Google Play version runs the model inside your phone and works offline. Here you'll also find the Windows version, which generates the stories on your PC, and its Android Wi-Fi client.
features: Local AI model: no servers, accounts or analytics
Kids mode: full screen, large text and PIN to exit
Spanish or English, for children, teens or adults
System voices with three reading speeds
Two free stories a day; one-time payment for unlimited (Google Play)
cuentero.notes: The direct APK is the Wi-Fi client that connects to the PC running Cuentero for Windows. The app that writes stories on the phone itself is on Google Play.

onionhost.tagline: Publish your website on the Tor network from your phone or PC
onionhost.description:
OnionHost turns your website or portfolio into a Tor network site with its own .onion address, reachable from anywhere in the world. No sign-ups, no domains to buy and no technical knowledge: pick your website's folder, flip the switch and your site is online.

Your own device serves the site: nothing is uploaded to any server.
features: Your own .onion address (v3 hidden services) generated on your device
Built-in Tor engine
Per-site switch, preview and log console
Share the address or open it in Tor Browser
Spanish and English
1 free site; unlimited with a one-time payment in the stores
onionhost.notes: In review on Google Play; already available on Microsoft Store. The direct Windows installer (.exe) has no site limit.
